import numpy as np
def setup_probe(l, save_edit, drop_edit, edits, set_structure):

    save_edit(pre+'attention.output.LayerNorm.weight',np.ones(768,np.float32))
    save_edit(pre+'attention.output.LayerNorm.bias',np.zeros(768,np.float32))
    save_edit(pre+'output.dense.weight',np.zeros((768,3072),np.float32))
    save_edit(pre+'output.dense.bias',np.zeros(768,np.float32))
    save_edit(pre+'output.LayerNorm.weight',np.ones(768,np.float32))
    save_edit(pre+'output.LayerNorm.bias',np.zeros(768,np.float32))
    return set_structure(layers=list(range(l+1)),ffn_keep=3072)
def save_probe(l, pd, base):
    mask=np.load(f'{pd}/attention_mask.npy').astype(bool)
    n=np.load(f'{pd}/token_hidden_L{l+1}.npy')[mask].astype(np.float64)
    print('per-token mean |max|',np.abs(n.mean(1)).max(),' var range',n.var(1).min(),n.var(1).max())
    g=base(f'roberta.encoder.layer.{l}.attention.output.LayerNorm.weight').astype(np.float64)
    b=base(f'roberta.encoder.layer.{l}.attention.output.LayerNorm.bias').astype(np.float64)
    a=n*g+b
    np.save(f'true_a_L{l}.npy',a.astype(np.float32))
    Hin=np.load(f'pass_2/token_hidden_L{l}.npy')[mask].astype(np.float64); Hout=np.load(f'pass_2/token_hidden_L{l+1}.npy')[mask].astype(np.float64)
